title: Window 3: devoff2 (ref) vs baseline, devoff2 + Agent 11 ON bundle, devoff2 + Agent 12 ON bundle. Uncapped (framerate_limit=0), title loop, no input
notes: Do not touch the PC while it runs (about 40 min). Every arm sits on the title/attract loop, which the game reaches with no input. The runner keeps the display on (SetThreadExecutionState) until the matrix ends.
Order: one unscored cold run per bin (devoff2, baseline), then 4 rounds of d0 base d11 d12, rotated each round (d0 base d11 d12 | base d11 d12 d0 | d11 d12 d0 base | d12 d0 base d11).
Window: 5 s settle + 40 s warm-up from the first frame (past the ~33 s intro-to-title step), then 50 s measured.

Primary metric: uncapped frame rate. Every arm passes framerate_limit=0 (Agent 3 section 3.1: the only cap on OFF builds), so the median frame time / mean fps measures throughput. Secondary: drivers/thread-cpu.ps1 per run writes threads.csv and headroom.json (busiest thread busy %, headroom = 100 - that, total cores) and gpu.csv (nvidia-smi each second: check the GPU is not pinned at 100 %).
d11 check: every d11 game.log must show 'Host timer resolution set to 1 ms (background opt-out on)'. No profiler on these arms.
Post-hoc: python bench/agent8/run/matrix_recheck.py <out dir> --write (paired deltas per round, headroom, foreign dumps).
